description: This file defines the FlatObject trait and its implementations, along with utility functions for reflection-based object flattening and normalization, used for data transformation and serialization.

classes.name: FlatEntry
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair for flattened data entries.

classes.name: TerminalFlatObject
classes.description: Trait for terminal flat objects with a fixed token.

classes.name: FlatNull
classes.description: Singleton object representing a null value.

classes.name: FlatPrimitive
classes.description: Wrapper for primitive values, extends TerminalFlatObject.

classes.name: FlatCollection
classes.description: Abstract class for collection types like sequences and sets.

classes.name: FlatSet
classes.description: Set collection of FlatObjects, sorted by string representation.

classes.name: FlatStruct
classes.description: Structured object wrapping a FlatMap with string keys.

methods.name: isPrimitive
methods.description: Checks if an object is a primitive type.

methods.name: mkMap
methods.description: Creates a map of field names to values using reflection.

methods.name: mapMaker
methods.description: Memoized function to generate a map of class fields.

methods.name: liftClass
methods.description: Lifts a class type into a FlatStruct using reflection.

methods.name: lift
methods.description: Converts various data types into a FlatObject.
